messages:
anna: Product asked for a way to let teams opt specific routes into richer telemetry without changing org-wide settings. Proposal: per-route consent tokens that encode scope, TTL, and max sample.

mike: quick q — will tokens be minted by product owners or platform? also how do we avoid a token granting too-wide access?

anna: plan: route owners mint tokens. token includes: route pattern, allowed field set, max_sample, expires. Default tokens = non-PII fields only.

jess: privacy: any token that enables PII fields must be explicit, require two approvers, and have a justification recorded. Audit every mint/refresh.

sven: ops note: tokens must be short-lived (1h) and KMS-signed. Reject tokens past TTL and log validation failures.

rahul: SRE concern: delegated routes can spike ingestion. Token should carry `max_sample` and a ingestion-side cap. Also add token-level burst limits.

anna: sketched header suggestion:
```
X-Route-Telemetry: v1;team=payments;routes=/payments/*;max_sample=0.01;exp=1767779400;sig=abc123
```

mike: console UX ideas: surface delegated routes, effective sample rate, owner, last_minted, and a revoke action. Also a quick preview of fields that would be sent.

jess: replays: allow ephemeral replay for debugging but require a replay ticket, scrub-run, and extra audit entry. No raw PII replays unless explicitly approved and time-boxed.

telemetry-bot: canary note — delegated tokens enabled for alpha teams (payments, billing) for 2w. Watch `telemetry.ingest.latency`, `telemetry.delegated.drop_rate`, `telemetry.ingest.bytes`.

sven: ingest pipeline: validate token, apply probabilistic sampling honoring `max_sample` at first touch, then run redaction heuristics. If token requests raw response fields and route isn't flagged for raw, reject.

rahul: add metrics: `telemetry.delegated.spike_count` and `telemetry.delegated.cost_delta`. Alert if per-route ingestion > baseline * 1.2 or cost delta > 10%.

mike: question on approvals: suggest approval owners = product owner + privacy engineering. Two-approver flow in console with required justification field.

jess: +1. I'll draft a privacy checklist to show in the mint flow: purpose, minimal fields, retention policy, replay rules.

anna: next steps: I'll write a short RFC with token schema, ingest enforcement, console mock, and audit flows. Will tag reviewers when it's up (ETA tomorrow AM). @mike @jess @sven @rahul please review.

mike: will do mockups.

sven: will prototype validation middleware.

rahul: will add metrics/alerts to SLO board.

jess: preparing the approver workflow and checklist.

anna: thanks — will post RFC and include a short runbook for monitoring during the canary.
